info.title: Masjid Sentral API
info.description: Master copy of masjids and their programmes for Jejak Masjid, Qiyam and other apps. Every request except `GET /` and `GET /openapi.json` needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (keys are server-side secrets; there is no CORS). Writes need the `write` scope, an `X-Sentral-Actor` header and, on POST/PATCH/DELETE, an `Idempotency-Key`; PATCH and DELETE also need `If-Match`. Routes under /admin need the `admin` scope. The integration contract (docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md) is the source of truth for client-visible behaviour.

post.summary: Merge a duplicate into a survivor
post.description: The masjid in the path is removed; `into` survives. One atomic write, changes in this order: the loser gets a `merge` change (`merged_into`, `moved_external_ids`), then each live programme an `event` `update` with the new masjid_id (`via_merge`), then the survivor an `update` (external_ids, `via_merge`). The response is the merged loser. A survivor may end up holding two ids from one app. Pending queue rows are resolved: the pair becomes `merged`, the loser's other pending pairs are re-pointed to the survivor. Masjids already merged into the loser now point at the survivor (one 301 hop). The optional `reason` is kept in the admin log only, never in `/changes`. More than 200 live programmes on the loser: 422 `details.reason: too_many_events`. `Idempotency-Key` required.

post.description: Field-level revert. For an `update`, only the fields listed in the change's `changed_fields` are restored, from its `before_json`, as a new write (actor `revert:<seq>:<admin actor>`, origin `sentral_admin`, current version). External ids: only the ids that change added or removed are undone, never the whole set. Contacts, facilities and images are restored only when listed. If a later change to the same entity touched any of those fields: 422 `stale_revert` with `details.later_seqs`, unless `?force=true` (the new change then has `forced: true` in `data`). Create revert = soft delete (cascades to programmes); delete revert = restore as active. 422 `validation_failed` for merges and the changes a merge made (`merge_not_revertable`), merged entities (`entity_merged`), an already-deleted/not-deleted entity, a programme whose masjid is not active, or a change with nothing to restore (`nothing_to_revert`). A concurrent write is 409; retry. `Idempotency-Key` required.

get.description: The scan runs hourly (25 masjids per search batch, 150 per run) and continues from its cursor. Use this to see progress, the last run, the last error, and whether a run is stalled (killed before finishing). After 3 unfinished runs on one cursor the next run goes one masjid at a time and skips (and lists in `skipped_ids`) any masjid that still fails.

bearerAuth.description: API key (`ms_live_...`). Scopes: read, write, webhook, admin.

code.description: Machine code. `already_exists` is admin-only (POST /admin/webhooks). `stale_revert` is admin-only (POST /admin/changes/{seq}/revert, 422).

available.description: false = confirmed not available; an absent code = unknown

url.description: Full HTTPS URL hosted by the sending app

external_id.description: Your id for this masjid; linked in the same write

contacts.description: Upserts by type; value null deletes it.

facilities.description: Upserts by code; available null deletes it. Retired codes can be cleared, not set.

MasjidPatch.description: Only the fields that changed. `images`, when present, replace the whole list.

oneOf.description: RFC 5545 RRULE without the RRULE: prefix

start_at.description: RFC 3339, `Z` or an offset; stored as UTC
RFC 3339, `Z` or an offset; stored as UTC

entity.description: More values may be added; ignore unknown ones

data.description: Full entity after the change, same shape as GET, plus the optional extra keys in `ChangeDataExtras`. An admin's merge `reason` is never included.

Duplicate.description: `masjid_a` < `masjid_b` by id. Produced by the hourly scan.

ChangeDataExtras.description: Optional extra keys a change's `data` may carry besides the entity fields. Ignore unknown keys.

via_merge.description: The change was made by merging this masjid id into another (survivor update, moved programme update).

moved_external_ids.description: On a `merge` change: the external ids that moved to the survivor.

merged_into.description: On a `merge` change: the survivor id.

forced.description: Set when an admin reverted despite later changes to the same fields.

cursor.description: Every masjid up to this (updated_at, id) has been scanned.

last_run_at.description: Start time of the last run (written before any work, so a killed run keeps it).

last_run_scanned.description: Masjids fully processed in the last run.

last_run_queued.description: Pairs newly queued in the last run.

last_error.description: `running` while a run is in flight (and for good if it was killed by the CPU limit); the message of the last failed run; null after a clean run.

stalled.description: True when `last_error` is `running` and `last_run_at` is more than 15 minutes old (the run was killed before it could record anything).

consecutive_failures.description: Runs started on the current cursor that did not advance it. At 3 the next run scans one masjid at a time. Reset when the cursor advances.

skipped_ids.description: Masjids skipped as poisoned (still failing when scanned alone), newest last, at most 100.
